review.official:
Steward is a member of Op Reserve Team A4 and a citizen of
Kjerag
. Before he officially took the position, he worked as a freelancer. After an exceptional performance on his tests, he received permission to join
Rhodes Island
and now serves on the reserve team.
He shows promise in the areas of
Arts
support, navigation, and combat support.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
He presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L
Infection has progressed to mid-stages. Currently there is no evidence of spreading.

Steward was born in the southern territory of Kjerag and spent his childhood being educated at home. He has a calm temperament that stands out amongst his peers and has a certain talent for Originium Arts. However, given the snowy environment and the high cost of studying Arts, this talent went uncultivated and was left buried in the heavy snow drifts of Kjerag.

The southern territory of Kjerag has long acted as the exit point for all of Kjerag. When the Silverash family declared a new economic policy, merchants from Columbia, Leithanien, and Rim Billiton launched several investment plans. During this period, Steward took the initiative to become a guide and local servicer for the business activities of merchants from all over the world. He also worked part-time as a model to help market goods. The brand new goods coming out of Columbia left a deep impression on Steward, and Steward's excellent service has garnered the praise of many merchants.

Snow Blue Wand
Quality Guaranteed by: Director of the Leithanian Arts Society

Manufacturer: Rudolf Bros. Wand Workshop
Product Number: ADD-143.
The Snow Blue wand used by Steward.
Proof of a Caster's mastery of Arts. Its handle has been engraved with the words 'Mythic Future.'
When you use it, you can hear the whistling of snow.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I have learned a lot. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What can I do for you?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They probably won't make it to tomorrow.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awarting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Gladly!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Freeze!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Down you go.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Did we make a mistake somewhere...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! And allow me to be your personal butler today! Steward, at your service.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.
